title: Henry Wallace, Astors and DuPonts fund Puharich's telepathy research

tellings.quote: I was unexpectedly put in contact with Henry A. Wallace, vice president under Franklin Delano Roosevelt.

plain: A researcher named Andrija Puharich, who studied telepathy, the idea of minds talking without words, says that in 1948 in Maine he was unexpectedly put in touch with Henry A. Wallace, a former US vice president under Franklin Roosevelt. According to the story, Wallace and the wealthy Astor and DuPont families went on to fund his telepathy research, which would mean powerful people were backing such work early on.
